Do not open a public issue for security problems.

Private reports only, through GitHub's advisory channel:

**[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/SonyPradana/dandelion/security/advisories/new)**

What to include, and what counts as in scope for this project, is documented in
[the security policy](https://github.com/SonyPradana/dandelion/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md).
